newsitem.title: USA: Myriad Genetics gets melanoma gene patent.
newsitem.headline: Myriad Genetics gets melanoma gene patent.

text.p: Myriad Genetics Inc said Wednesday that it has been granted a patent by the U.S. Patent and Trademark Office, covering MTS1 melanoma gene mutations.

The Multiple Tumor Suppressor 1 ("MTS1") gene patent covers the composition of matter on germline mutations that predispose individuals to melanoma and a method for the identification of individuals who have an increased risk of developing melanoma.

Also covered under Myriad's MTS1 patent are cloning vectors containing mutated MTS1 DNA and an expression system comprising these mutated DNAs, as well as recombinant host cells transformed with these vectors.
Myriad said that the patent was awarded during its development of a genetic test for inherited susceptibility to melanoma based on the MTS1 gene.
